page.running_head: DISP. DE ACQU. DOM. IURIS GENT.

main_text.l: §. litera Instit. de rer. div. eo quod non fiat pars formalis charta Coed. d. loc. Mynsing putat olim propterea scripturam chartæ cessisse, quod charta olim in maximo fuerit pretio: Id vero hodie cum non in tanto pretio sit non similiter obtinere. Resp. vid. apud Foman. d. disp. 9. th. 23.

page.notes: Below FINIS sits a woodcut ornament (a head within scrollwork, with a leafy base); it carries no printed text. The oval library stamp ("BIBLIOTECA ... ROMA ... VITTORIO EMANUELE") is excluded. The faint lines in the lower half of the scan are show-through from the other side and are not transcribed. No page number, catchword or signature is printed. The annotation lines are set in italic type, though some abbreviations ("Coed.", "d.", "Resp.") may be roman. The ß-like "§" at the start is read as a section sign. "Mynsing" and "Foman." are read as printed; the scan is slightly blurred around "Foman." and "d.disp.9.th.23", so these may need checking against the original.
